story.title: Sarvam AI Hits $1.5 Billion Valuation — Its 105B-Parameter Model Now Rivals Global Giants
story.summary: Sarvam AI, India's sovereign AI startup founded in Bengaluru in 2023, is closing a $350 million funding round at a $1.5 billion valuation — making it one of the most valuable AI companies ever built in India. At the India AI Impact Summit in February 2026, Sarvam unveiled two large language models: Sarvam-30B and the flagship Sarvam-105B, a 105-billion parameter mixture-of-experts model with a 128,000-token context window capable of complex reasoning and enterprise tasks. Both models are optimised for Indian languages, edge deployment, and data sovereignty. India is no longer just consuming global AI — it is building frontier models that compete at the top of global benchmarks.
